claims.title: Excitation-supply tails and explicit collective-jump circuits are proposed for coherent full-channel simulation

status: source_derived_unreviewed; Source-reported mathematical arguments only. Intake checked byte preservation and repository structure; no independent proof reconstruction, scientific-code replay, citation verification, formal proof, quantum circuit execution, or experimental validation was performed. External correctness and historical priority remain UNKNOWN.
interface: For n two-level emitters, Q=sum_i q_i and supplied classical finite-precision C in C^(r x n), collective photon jumps are L_mu=sum_i c_mu,i sigma_i^-. The model includes a supplied commuting diagonal H0=sum_i d_i q_i+sum_ij u_ij q_i q_j, exchange Hamiltonian, coherent drives Omega_i, local pumps sqrt(p_i)sigma_i^+ and dephasing sqrt(kappa_i)Z_i. Inhomogeneous coefficients and arbitrary connectivity are allowed and charged; no permutation symmetry is assumed. Input support is Q<=k0; k0=n allows an unrestricted unknown state entangled with a reference. Output is the full Markovian channel to diamond error epsilon and specified observables, not a laboratory-validated microscopic model.
limits: Independently reconstruct the tilted-number inequality and uniform cutoff, the interference-preserving A/C circuits and coherent selector inverses, and the N701 first-event compiler/discretization and diamond-error composition. Compile the promised fixed-length circuit and compare full resources with equally informed current and specialized algorithms; charge coefficient acquisition, coherent input preparation, measurement and fault tolerance before claiming an operational advantage.
